problem:
If $\,T\,$ is a linear transformation and $\,T([\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -2\end{aligned}]$, then find $T([\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 12\end{aligned}]).$

| $\,T([\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 12\end{aligned}])=\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
worked_solution:
Since $T$ is a linear transformation, it must satisfy $T(kv)=kT(v).$ Noting that $[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 12\end{aligned}]=-3[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4\end{aligned}],$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T([\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 12\end{aligned}]) & =T(-3[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4\end{aligned}]) \\  & =-3T([\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4\end{aligned}]) \\  & =-3[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-24 \\ 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
